'''Zeck Tambell''' was a member of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tren Pergallis]]' [[Special Investigations squad]] on [[Stassia]]. He transferred to the post after spending two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] serving aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Arbiter (Star Destroyer)|''Arbiter'']].
